description:
HIGH ON LOVE
“The Art of Juicy Relationship”

🌹 SACRED SEXUALITY TALK 🌹
 Saturday 28th February - Aljezur

Warm Welcome as You Are!

This workshop is perfect for singles, couples, men, women, non-binary. We open a space to come together to share and understand the mysterious ways of Sexuality. This talk is for you if you want to heal, evolve, deepen and unlock your multi-orgasmic superpowers. 

During this talk we will share juicy practical knowledge to create a vibrant foundation for the Sexuality of our dream.

Integrating Conscious Sexuality as your personal practice, healing art and spiritual path you will feel more vitality, connected to yourself, authentic, safe, powerful, peaceful and connected to other. You will generate lot of extra energy to uplift you, boost your creativity and your projects.

You can bring your main questions of the moment around those subjects and we will weave some propositions of answers and offer practical keys and tools for you to explore. 

All excercices and demo will be with clothes during the workshop. 

At 7pm we close the circle and we open the sauna and cold plunge for those who want to stay to keep sharing around the fire (sauna+soup 10€)

Let's say yes to Life and open up to Bloom! 🌺

Saturday 28 February
⭐️ 10am -7pm⭐️
In the Shala
Essência Nature Retreat, Aljezur
Energy exchange sliding scale : €33 - 44€
Organic vegan juice, light lunch & tea break included 

Book your spot for lunch preparation
❤️ Simona +351 91 444 81 88

🙏🏼 Much Love,

Simona & Antoine

Simona has been studying taoist tantra and accompanying women and men for 15 years. With Antoine, we walk this conscious path since 7 years and offer life+business coaching, couples coaching, meditation, yoga and tantra retreats. we serve together as doula for natural home births. Our practice has created a strong bond and lot of energy to co-found 5 projects. We are so grateful for this Knowledge we have received we are passionate to share it with everyone willing to choose Life and to open their wings !
